steps.value: for (var attempt = 0; attempt < 10; attempt++) { var target = null; var modals = document.querySelectorAll('.byte-modal__content, [role=dialog], .modal-content, .bytedance-modal, .byte-drawer, [class*=modal], [class*=dialog], [class*=Modal], [class*=Dialog], .byte-modal, .byte-dialog'); for (var i = 0; i < modals.length; i++) { var m = modals[i]; if (m.offsetParent === null) continue; var btns = m.querySelectorAll('button'); for (var j = 0; j < btns.length; j++) { var t = (btns[j].innerText || '').trim(); if (t === '确认发布' || t === '确认' || t === '发布' || t === '确定' || t === '提交' || t === '确认发表' || t === '发表') { target = btns[j]; break; } } if (target) break; } if (!target) { var allBtns = document.querySelectorAll('button'); for (var k = 0; k < allBtns.length; k++) { var b = allBtns[k]; if (b.offsetParent === null) continue; var bt = (b.innerText || '').trim(); if (bt === '确认发布' || bt === '确认' || bt === '确定' || bt === '提交' || bt === '确认发表' || bt === '发表') { target = b; break; } } } if (target) { target.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); var r = target.getBoundingClientRect(); target.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, clientX: r.x + r.width / 2, clientY: r.y + r.height / 2 })); return 'clicked: ' + (target.innerText || '').trim() + ' (attempt=' + attempt + ')'; } await new Promise(function(res) { setTimeout(res, 1000); }); } throw new Error('预览弹窗内未找到确认发布按钮（轮询10秒）');
